description:
Famewall is a testimonial platform with which users collect written, video and audio testimonials from their customers, then display the approved ones on their website. 

This plugin connects ChatGPT to the testimonials you have already collected.

The value is having them where you are already writing. 

If you are drafting a landing page, a case study, or a sales email, ask for the quotes that mention pricing, or onboarding, or whichever objection you are answering. Real sentences from real customers, with names and job titles attached, instead of a placeholder you will fill in later.

It works the other way too. When a customer sends you something good over email or Slack, paste it in and ask ChatGPT to add it to the right wall  - no dashboard, no form.

You can also check what has arrived recently, search everything you have collected by keyword, rating or source, see which submissions are still waiting on your review, and fix a typo or an out-of-date job title.

defaultPrompt: Find testimonials I could use on a landing page
A customer just sent me a great message. Help me add it as a testimonial
What's come in recently, and is anything waiting for my review?
